title: thymus serpyllum var. stenophyllus
intro: Thymus serpyllum var. stenophyllus, commonly known as the narrow-leaved thyme, is a subspecies of the thyme plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This herb is known for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to boost the immune system, reduce stress, and protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of narrow-leaved thyme include its ability to act as a digestive aid, a respiratory decongestant, and a wound healer, due to its bioactive constituents such as thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid. The bioactive constituents of narrow-leaved thyme have been found to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
